title: a.r.t.e.s. Doctoral Scholarships

provider.name: a.r.t.e.s. Graduate School for the Humanities Cologne

summary: 8 Integrated Track Doctoral Scholarships awarded by a.r.t.e.s. Graduate School for the Humanities Cologne for pursuing a structured doctorate in the humanities.

degree_levels.notes: Covers qualification levels of academic training in the arts and humanities from Master to postdoc, but the specific scholarship award is for doctoral candidates in the Integrated Track.

subject_areas.notes: Addresses graduates of the humanities; faculty covers arts and humanities.

institutions.notes: Hosted by a.r.t.e.s. Graduate School for the Humanities Cologne at the University of Cologne.

nationality.notes: The Graduate School would like to further support international students hailing from outside of the EU, but specific allowed/excluded nationalities are not exhaustively listed.

residence.notes: Residence status in or outside Germany is not explicitly restricted, though international students hailing from outside of the EU are explicitly supported.

mandatory.text: Must have passed all examinations determining the final grade in order to qualify

preferences.text: Applicants who successfully completed their studies as quickly as possible and look for immediate funding opportunities after their final examination
Young researchers from non-academic family backgrounds
International students hailing from outside of the EU

exceptions.text: Special circumstances such as parental and family leaves, obligatory state and military services, illnesses, disabilities and/or voluntary work can be recognised if evidence is provided

funding.description: Full scholarship of EUR 1700 per month awarded for three years.

application_rounds.notes: Application deadline for the scholarship starting April 1, 2027. University diploma and report on degree thesis may be handed in later by November 24, 2026.

required_documents.text: Covering letter providing a statement of your motivation to apply
Scans of university diplomas and transcripts of records (including Bachelor's degree if applying with a Master's, authorized translations if necessary, and grading system overview)
Report on the degree thesis (e.g. M.A. thesis)
Research proposal for the doctoral dissertation project (7,000–12,000 characters incl. spaces plus footnotes, appendix & bibliography)
Expert report on the doctoral dissertation project

steps.text: Create an account with a.r.t.e.s. access web portal
Choose the application procedure 'a.r.t.e.s. doctoral scholarships (starting April 2026)' [Note: page text states starting April 2026 in portal instruction despite 2027 start]
Fill in general information about yourself and your doctoral dissertation project
Upload required application documents via the web portal by October 29, 2026
Submit expert report separately via e-mail to artes-application@uni-koeln.de

sources.title: Application
sources.notes: The scholarship funds doctoral students for doing research and completing a dissertation in the humanities at the University of Cologne in Germany.
